home.title: Your wardrobe, simplified
home.subtitle: Put outfits together and keep your wardrobe at your fingertips.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: An unexpected problem occurred. You can try again.

ui.title: Base components
ui.intro: Internal page, only available in development.

states.emptyDescription: Add your first garment to get started.
states.errorDescription: Check your connection and try again.
states.loadingDescription: One moment, we are preparing your wardrobe.

dialog.title: Dialog
dialog.body: Focus stays trapped here until it is closed.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This page does not exist or has moved.

common.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address, for example name@example.com.
common.rateLimitedTitle: Too many attempts, try again in {minutes} min.
common.networkText: Check your internet connection and try again.
common.unavailableText: Try again in a few moments.
common.unexpectedText: Try again. If the problem persists, reload the page.

password.hint: At least 12 characters. An easy-to-remember passphrase is ideal.
password.too_short: The password must be at least 12 characters long.
password.too_long: The password must not exceed 128 characters.
password.too_common: This password is too common. Choose another one.
password.matches_email: The password must not repeat your email address.
password.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

login.title: Sign in
login.invalidText: Check your details and try again.
login.limitedText: For your security, signing in is temporarily suspended. You can also reset your password.
login.notVerifiedText: Open the link we emailed you, or ask for a new one.

register.title: Create an account
register.lead: It only takes a few seconds.
register.terms: I accept the terms of use and the privacy policy.
register.termsRequired: You must accept to create an account.
register.limitedText: For your security, sign-ups from this device are temporarily suspended.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.text: If this address can be used, a verification email has just been sent. Open the link it contains to activate your account. Remember to check your spam folder.
verify.cooldown: You can ask for a new email in 60 seconds.
verify.resent: If an account awaiting verification exists for this address, a new email has been sent.
verify.successText: Your account is active. Sign in: two quick steps remain to personalise Lookiva.
verify.invalidTitle: This link has expired or was already used
verify.invalidText: For your security, a link works only once and for a limited time. Ask for a new one.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.lead: Enter your email address. We will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentText: If an account exists for this address, an email has been sent. The link can be used once.
forgot.limitedTitle: Too many requests, try again in {minutes} min.

reset.title: New password
reset.lead: Choose a password you do not use anywhere else.
reset.successText: For your security, all your sessions have been signed out, including on this device. Sign in again with your new password.
reset.allSessionsText: Devices affected: this device and all the others.
reset.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
reset.invalidText: It has expired or was already used. Ask for a new reset link.

onboarding.title: Welcome
onboarding.languageLead: You can change it at any time in the settings.
onboarding.cityLead: It is used for the weather of your outfits. No GPS position is needed.
onboarding.searchHint: Type at least 2 letters. Nothing is shared until you confirm.
onboarding.noResults: No results for “{q}”. Enter your city below.
onboarding.searchError: Search is unavailable. Enter your city below.
onboarding.gpsHint: Optional. You can always choose your city yourself, without sharing your location.
onboarding.gpsDeniedText: Permission denied or unavailable: no problem, search for your city above or enter it by hand.
onboarding.gpsOkText: It will complete a city typed by hand below. A suggested city keeps its own position.
onboarding.manualTitle: My city is not in the list
onboarding.cityRequired: Choose a suggested city or enter your city.

sessions.title: Sessions and devices
sessions.lead: The devices signed in to your account. Revoke the ones you do not recognise.
sessions.revokedText: {device} no longer has access to your account.
sessions.logoutAllHint: Signs out all your devices, including this one.
sessions.confirmText: All your devices will be signed out, including this one. You will need to sign in again.

profile.title: Profile and preferences
profile.aiText: Off by default. No photo is ever sent: only text descriptions may be used, and only if you turn this on.
profile.learningText: Lookiva adapts to the outfits you accept or reject.
profile.thermalHint: Adjusts the advice to the weather.
profile.conflictText: They were changed from another device or tab. Reload to see the latest version, then make your changes again.
profile.export: Request an export of my data
profile.exportText: The request is recorded; Lookiva does not generate the export file yet.
profile.exportLimited: You have reached the limit of 3 requests per day.
profile.deleteText: You will be signed out of all your devices. Technical backups are not purged immediately: their copies remain until they expire.
profile.deleteConfirmText: Confirm with your password. All your sessions will be closed. Backups are not purged immediately.
profile.deletedText: You have been signed out of all your devices. Backups are not purged immediately.

wardrobe.title: My wardrobe
wardrobe.emptyText: Add your first piece to get started.

new.title: New garment
new.lead: Category, subtype and main colour are required.

detail.trashTitle: Move this garment to the trash?
detail.trashText: It stays in the trash for 30 days before permanent deletion.
detail.photosHint: Up to 5 photos of 10 MB each (JPEG, PNG or WebP).

errors.conflict: This garment changed elsewhere. Reload the page before trying again.
errors.photoUnsupported: Unsupported format: JPEG, PNG or WebP only.

trash.title: Trash
trash.lead: Garments stay here for 30 days before permanent deletion.
